owner_posts.post_text:
The 'Color Temperature' Trick That Instantly Makes Your Living Room Feel Like a Luxury Spa

One small lighting change, one huge mood shift.

You know that feeling when you walk into a spa or a luxury hotel,  calm music, soft ambience, everything glowing warm and gentle? It's as if time slows down a little. What most people don’t notice is that the magic behind all these feelings does not lie in the décor but rather in the color temperature of the lighting.

Change the color tone of light in your living room, and voila-the same space starts looking expensive, cozy, and beautifully put-together. You do not need a makeover, new furniture, or fancy décor, as the right lighting temperature will do it.

What is meant by color temperature?

Color temperature is simply the shade of white light your room gets. Some lights look warm and golden, others cool and bright. Warm lights are cozy and relaxing, while cooler lights are energetic and sharp.

This is the difference in tone, which affects mood more than we think. Ever wondered why a warm café feels comforting, and an office feels alert and bright? It's due to the light.

Most luxury homes use warm white lighting around 2700K-3000K because it instantly creates softness. It flatters furnishings, makes skin tones appear better, and makes evenings feel intimate rather than stark.

Cooler light has its purpose - kitchens, reading corners, and worktables - but when it comes to living rooms, warm is almost always the winner.

Stop Buying Cheap Strip Lights: Here’s Why Your Home Looks Dingy


Why Cheap Strip Lights Look Bad
1. They flicker or look patchy
Cheap strips use low-quality chips and power drivers. Over time, you’ll see blinking at low brightness levels, uneven luminosity, or tiny “hot dots” instead of a seamless light wash. In a living room or bedroom, that instantly cheapens the look.

2. Wrong color temperature = wrong vibe
Most budget strips default to icy cool light (that blueish tone). It’s harsh on skin tones, makes furniture look washed-out, and kills the cozy aesthetic you were aiming for. Instead of warm ambience, you get hospital lighting.

3. They die fast
Cheaper strips burn out faster, turn pinkish with age, or dim randomly section by section. You thought you'd saved money, but you actually buy twice.

4. Low CRI makes everything look dull.
Colour Rendering Index (CRI) affects how true colours appear. Cheap strips often have low CRI. Wood grains look flat. Decor looks greyish. Food doesn’t look appetizing.

Good lighting brings everything into reality.

featured_reviews.name: Rizwan Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst service and a very disappointing experience. The staff, especially Iqbal and Manish, were extremely unprofessional.
They promised to deliver my dining table, dining chairs, sofa, and accent chair within one week, but failed to keep their commitment. I had to constantly follow up with them, and even after two weeks, I still had not received all my items. The products were delivered one by one instead of together.
When I finally received the sofa after two weeks, it was a complete disappointment. It came in two different shades of beige and had two different fabric textures on the same sofa. To make matters worse, it was full of stains. This was completely unacceptable and raised serious concerns about their quality control.
Initially, they told me that the dining table, dining chairs, and accent chair would arrive within 2–3 days because the products were already in Mumbai. However, after a week of waiting, they informed me that the items had not even been dispatched from Bangalore. This clearly shows that they were not honest about the delivery status and misled us regarding the availability of the products.
Instead of taking responsibility for their failure to fulfill their promises, they accused us and behaved rudely. The staff also lacked basic customer service skills. Phrases like “arey arey” were used while speaking to us, which was highly unprofessional, especially considering that we had already paid for everything in full.
At this point, I no longer want the accent chair. The entire experience has been stressful, frustrating, and mentally exhausting. I do not wish to continue arguing or repeatedly following up for something that should have been handled professionally from the beginning. Therefore, I request a full refund for the accent chair.
Overall, this has been a very poor experience, both in terms of customer service and product quality. I would not recommend this store based on my experience.

Extremely unsafe and unresponsive - Fan blades fell when someone was sleeping.

We bought a fan from Fanzart about 15 years ago, trusting their reputation for high-quality and luxury design. But what happened recently was downright shocking.

The fan had been making noises for a couple of days. We reached out to Fanzart customer support — no response. This isn’t new; getting maintenance or service from them has always been a challenge over the years.

And then — the fan cover and blades literally fell off the mount while someone was sleeping on the bed directly underneath. Luckily, there were no serious injuries, but it could have been disastrous.

The ceiling fitting is still intact, meaning this was a failure inside the fan’s internal structure — which is completely unacceptable, especially from a premium brand like Fanzart.

If this is the safety standard they offer, it’s honestly not worth the designer label. Would strongly urge others to think twice before choosing Fanzart — especially if you care about safety and service responsiveness.
